content.short: Pengu Clash is a skill-based multiplayer game by the Pudgy Penguins team built specifically for TON.
content.description: Pengu Clash is an engaging, skill-based multiplayer game developed by the renowned Pudgy Penguins team for the TON blockchain. Accessible via a Telegram Mini App, it features fast-paced 1v1 challenges such as Darts, Football, and 'Bomber' games. Unlike traditional inflationary models, Pengu Clash utilizes a 'play-to-win' approach where rewards are distributed based on competition mastery and player skill. By leveraging the popular Pudgy Penguins IP, the game provides a fun and competitive entry point for users to engage with Web3 gaming on the TON network.
content.meta: Challenge others and win with Pengu Clash on TON. Pudgy Penguins gaming on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
